responsibility: Groups the baked list-formatting data exposed by this crate, currently serving as the namespace for the `AndListV1` dataset used by the generated provider macros.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `data/mod.rs`, which installs provider implementations for the whole baked dataset, and unlike `and_v1/mod.rs`, which stores the locale-indexed list patterns, this `mod.rs` is just the namespace module for the list subtree.
